goal: Specify source library and parser status UI for supported, partial, deferred, unsupported, failed, and recovery states.
non_goals: Do not claim full local parsing for deferred complex formats.
Do not silently discard unsupported files.
Do not build signed or release APKs.
Do not modify existing mobile/ Capacitor/PWA release packaging.
Do not touch signing files, alias reverse-tutor, or existing applicationId com.reversetutor.app.
Do not mark native replacement readiness unless this is an explicitly approved Phase 6 readiness task with complete evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Parser status UI spec distinguishes supported, partial, deferred, unsupported, failed, and recovery states.
User-facing copy and recovery actions are specified for source import and parser outcomes.
Dependencies on source library, simple parser, complex parser status, and UX foundation work are recorded.
No prohibited package/signing/PWA release changes are made.
verification_expectations: Validate the parser status UI spec is internally consistent with Phase 5 source/parser ownership.
Run JSON validation for modified ADworkflo specs.
If UI files are changed by the future worker, run Compose/UI state tests where available and capture screenshots when feasible.
notes: Added as a Phase 5 UI/UX follow-up to split source/parser status UI decisions out of the broad NATIVE-UX-005 surface task.
Use deterministic tests and fakes; real LLM/provider/network/device actions require explicit scope and evidence.
